name: researcher
description: Research-focused autonomous agent for evidence collection.

unmappedExclusions.planframe_*: no dsh analog (durable workflow plans are not a tool surface)
unmappedExclusions.scheduler_*: schedule_create/delete/list are not mounted in the standard composition
unmappedExclusions.eval_*: no dsh analog (eval runs are persona work, not tools)
unmappedExclusions.credential_*: dsh resolves credentials per-operation (CredentialRef), no model-facing tool
unmappedExclusions.wiki_*: no dsh analog (knowledge plane deferred by the port plan)
unmappedExclusions.capsule_*: Phase 7 machinery — no dsh tool yet
unmappedExclusions.admin_proposal_*: Phase 8 amendment machinery — no dsh tool yet
unmappedExclusions.session_*: session query is host-side, not a model-facing tool
unmappedExclusions.sentinel_*: ported as CI-side gates, not model-facing tools
unmappedExclusions.constitution_*: the constitution is a service, not a tool
unmappedExclusions.artifact_exec: no dsh tool, and none is coming: the artifact store was dropped in the Phase 6 re-scope (docs/decision-phase6-scope.md) because no clause of the Compact asks for it
unmappedExclusions.artifact_build: no dsh tool, and none is coming: the artifact store was dropped in the Phase 6 re-scope (docs/decision-phase6-scope.md) because no clause of the Compact asks for it
unmappedExclusions.artifact_prepare: no dsh tool, and none is coming: the artifact store was dropped in the Phase 6 re-scope (docs/decision-phase6-scope.md) because no clause of the Compact asks for it

returns.description: Flexible research result object. Include only the fields that are actually available for this task; all listed properties are optional unless a caller explicitly requested a stricter shape.

status.description: High-level status of the research result.

summary.description: Optional compact synthesis of the research result.

content_handle.description: Optional session content handle for stored fetched material.

fetch_record_id.description: Optional session-visible knowledge record id indexing a stored fetch.

sources.description: Optional list of cited sources or source descriptors.

clarification_request.description: Required when status is clarification_needed; asks for missing user input needed to proceed.

question.description: The exact question the user should answer.

context.description: Brief reason why this clarification is needed.
